name: Tracknow for WooCommerce
author: Tracknow

sections.description:
WordPress Affiliate Tracking Plugin

This plugin integrates Tracknow affiliate tracking with WooCommerce. To properly track conversions and assign commissions to affiliates, the plugin sends purchase-related information to Tracknow’s tracking servers.

Tracknow is a cutting-edge affiliate tracking software designed for eCommerce, services, networks, IB, and iGaming. It offers features such as automated affiliate payouts, multi-level marketing (MLM), lifetime commissions, API integration, fraud prevention, offline tracking, and more!

To explore all the features, please visit:
Tracknow Prices

Features

  • Automatic integration with the WooCommerce plugin
  • Lifetime payments
  • Coupon Tracking
  • Multi Level Marketing (MLM)
  • Designed & Branded

Learn more:

Screenshots

Caption: Settings page in WordPress admin under WooCommerce Settings.

Data Sent to External Service

This plugin sends purchase tracking data, including order details and affiliate identifiers, to Tracknow’s secure tracking servers (*.tracknow.info). This is required to properly track affiliate sales, assign commissions, and provide accurate reporting within the Tracknow platform.

No sensitive payment information is sent. The data collected follows Tracknow’s privacy policies, which can be reviewed at:
Tracknow Privacy Policy

Service Requirement

To use this plugin, a Tracknow account is required. You can sign up for FREE at:
Tracknow Register Page

Installation

  1. Install easily with the WordPress plugin control panel or manually download the plugin and upload the folder tracknow-for-woocommerce to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Fill required fields and enable plugin functionality in the settings (Admin > WooCommerce > Settings > Tracknow)

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I set up Tracknow for WooCommerce?

Follow the installation instructions provided in the readme. Once activated, navigate to WooCommerce settings in your WordPress admin and configure Tracknow by entering your Tracknow credentials.

What data does the plugin send to Tracknow?

The plugin sends purchase tracking data such as order details and affiliate IDs to Tracknow’s secure servers. No sensitive payment information is transmitted.

Where can I get my Namespace?

The Namespace is the same as the workspace you inserted under Tracknow registration and is the prefix of your personal affiliate platform namespace.tracknow.io.

Where do I get the Campaign ID?

You can find the Campaign ID on the Tracknow platform in two main places:

  1. In the URL of the campaign page:
    https://dashboard.tracknow.io/app/management/campaign/1/campaign-details
    (where 1 is the campaign ID in this example).

  2. In the campaigns table under the ID column:
    https://dashboard.tracknow.io/app/management/campaigns.

In most cases, 1 is the campaign ID when working with the initial campaign created.

Where can I get support for Tracknow for WooCommerce?

For support inquiries, please contact us here.

  • Stability improvements and minor internal refactors to enhance reliability under edge conditions.
  • API Key Validation: Added functionality to validate API key before processing conversions, ensuring that only valid keys trigger updates.
  • Status Monitor: Introduced a status monitor to track conversion status updates and automatically update conversions to APPROVED or DENIED based on order status changes.

10.0.14

  • Stability improvements and minor internal refactors to enhance reliability under edge conditions.

10.0.13

  • Added support for detecting coupon codes stored in custom order meta fields.
  • New setting: “Custom Coupon Meta Key” – allows mapping a meta key used by third-party coupon logic.

10.0.12

  • Improved first purchase recognition by ignoring unsuccessful orders

10.0.11

  • Added option to disable lifetime tracking for enhanced user privacy.

  • Enhanced backend country verification for better location accuracy.

  • Added option to include client personal information in the tracking URL.
